highlights.sectionIntro: Applied and fundamental research axes organized around a transversal theme: AI and data science for the sustainable development of Haiti and the Caribbean.
highlights.transversalText: Artificial intelligence and data science for the sustainable development of Haiti and the Caribbean

axes.title: Fundamental AI Methods and Machine Learning
axes.description: Developing methods suited to scarce, noisy or heterogeneous data, self-supervised learning, transfer learning, robustness and frugal AI.

axes.title: Computer Vision and Complex Data Analysis
axes.description: Image, document and multimodal data analysis, particularly for agriculture, health, environment and document processing in Haitian Creole and French.

axes.title: Robust, Explainable and Responsible AI
axes.description: Model explainability, algorithmic fairness, bias detection and mitigation, robustness, AI system auditing and evaluation of limitations.

axes.title: AI for Healthcare
axes.description: Medical image analysis, screening and clinical decision support, epidemiological surveillance, documentary assistants and health interfaces in Haitian Creole.

axes.title: AI for Digital Agriculture and Environmental Resilience
axes.description: Crop disease detection, agronomic recommendations, satellite image analysis, early warning systems and climate change adaptation.

axes.title: AI for Socioeconomic, Educational and Institutional Systems
axes.description: Decision support, digital transformation, document automation, Haitian Creole processing and tool development for education, public administration and the economy.

fallbackItems.summary: Our team presented the lab's scientific roadmap at the regional AI symposium.

fallbackItems.title: Call for applications — 2025 research program

fallbackItems.title: Creole NLP: first results in modeling Haitian Creole
fallbackItems.summary: A significant breakthrough in automatic processing of Haitian Creole with our in-house models.
